## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? -->

## Type of change

<!-- Pick the one matching your commit type (drives the release). -->

- [ ] `fix:` — bug fix (patch)
- [ ] `feat:` — new feature (minor)
- [ ] `docs:` / `chore:` / `test:` / `ci:` / `refactor:` — no release

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated and `pnpm test --run` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm format:check` pass
- [ ] Added a fixture in `fixtures/` if output handling changed
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Updated relevant docs (README, `examples/`) if behaviour changed
